title: Rotate Array
prompt: Given an integer array `nums`, rotate the array to the right by `k` steps, where `k` is non-negative. Return the rotated array (you don't need to mutate in place for this exercise).
hints: k can be larger than the array length — think about what k % len(nums) means.
A slicing-based solution (last k elements + first n-k elements) is a clean O(n) approach.
For a follow-up, discuss doing it in-place with O(1) extra space using the reverse-three-times trick.
